name: agent-content-firewall
tagline_zh: 正经办公文档：agent-content-firewall。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Screen untrusted local documents, attachments, web content, messages, and tool output before an agent reads or acts on them. Use for PDF, DOCX, HTML, images, copied third-party text, MCP resources, and other externally supplied content where hidden or indirect instructions could manipulate the agent.
